name: dsh-rust-dev
description: Rust development as a surface: six tools over the machine's own toolchain - `rust_status` (the four facts that fail independently: toolchain, components, installed targets, the workspace), `cargo_check` (diagnostics parsed from `--message-format=json`, with codes and file:line:col), `cargo_test`, `cargo_build` (artifact path and real size), `rust_deps` (duplicate crate versions, features and the chain that enabled them) and `rust_backtrace` (demangled frames, separated into your workspace and dependencies) - plus four skills (workspaces, diagnostics, debugging, and egui/eframe/wgpu apps). Every cargo call is `--offline` by default, every answer names the command it ran, and nothing installs a toolchain or a crate. Host-only: one row, no route, no browser half, zero npm dependencies.
